h2. Goals
 * Send a confirmation email when an order is placed
 * Keep the existing on-screen confirmation
 * Send the email and the receipt as separate messages

h2. Current situation
h3. order-service

This service stores the orders. One row per order, with status PLACED.

The row is written in the same transaction as the payment.
h3. mail-sender

In a loop:
 * read the next unsent messages
 * hand them to the mail server
 * mark them as sent

h2. Solution design
 
Message:
 * add the field orderId

{code:java}
record OrderPlaced(String id, OrderStatus status) {}
{code}

||Field||Required||
|id|yes|
|status|yes|

See [the mail server notes|https://wiki.example.com/mail] and !flow.png|thumbnail!

h2. Conditions of Satisfaction
 * every message carries orderId
 * the sender skips orders whose status is not PLACED
